Sales CRM: deals, persons, organizations, activities and pipelines.

## API key

- **Get your key here:** [app.pipedrive.com](https://app.pipedrive.com/settings/api)
- **Setting:** `PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN`
- **API reference:** [developers.pipedrive.com](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1)

### Get the key

1. Sign in to Pipedrive and open [app.pipedrive.com](https://app.pipedrive.com/settings/api).
2. Create an API key (or token) with only the access your apps need.
3. Copy it. Many providers show a key only once.

**What to create:** A personal API token from Settings > Personal preferences > API in Pipedrive; the Gateway sends it in the x-api-token header. If API is missing there, an admin enables it for the person's permission set.

Steps for this provider are brief. [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Pipedrive) to request a full guide.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
pnpm everyapp secret set PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN
```

It asks for the value at a hidden prompt, and it's live at once, with no deploy. If an app you've installed needs it, `pnpm everyapp configure <app>` asks for it along with everything else the app needs.

### Use it in an app

List it in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  pipedrive: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

`access` is `"read"` (or `"write"` where it changes things). The app calls the provider's own URLs with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

### Check it worked

- `pnpm everyapp provider show pipedrive` shows the key as set and which apps use it.
- `pnpm everyapp status` shows apps that were waiting for it as ready.
- To test the key itself, `GET https://api.pipedrive.com/v1/users/me` with it should answer 200; the call is free.

### Cost and limits

- **Cost:** Each endpoint spends API tokens from a daily company budget of 30,000 x plan multiplier (1 to 7) x seats.
- **Rate limits:** Per API token: 20 (Lite) to 120 (Ultimate) requests per 2 seconds; Search 10 per 2 seconds.
